description: Set within a secure and sought-after estate, this architecturally striking home offers an impressive blend of modern design, clean lines, and natural finishes. The bold facade, defined by sleek grey tones, double-volume glass panels, and stone accents, creates an immediate sense of grandeur upon arrival. The property boasts a spacious double garage with glass-paneled doors, a large paved driveway, and a landscaped garden with established trees and manicured greenery. A dramatic entrance framed by tall columns and floor-to-ceiling windows sets the tone for the stylish interior. Welcome to this beautifully maintained three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and functionality in a secure estate setting. Upon entering, you're greeted by a bright, double-volume foyer that leads into an expansive open-plan living area....
pool_mentions: The patio overlooks a sparkling L-shaped pool with a cover and net, and a timber deck perfect for relaxing or hosting guests.
